Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support further upside.

Silver.note: Strong industrial demand from solar panels combined with monetary premium.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and green energy transition demand remain robust.

Uranium.note: Long-term utility contracting and primary supply deficits underpin prices.

Lithium.note: Persistent oversupply and moderating EV demand growth weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Massive Indonesian supply growth and LFP battery substitution create surplus.

Zinc.note: Mine closures and tight concentrate markets are tightening refined balances.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property construction limits steel demand upside.

Coal.note: Stable near-term demand but long-term energy transition and ESG pressures cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks and EV motor demand provide a floor despite current softness.

Manganese.note: Steady steelmaking demand and localized supply disruptions support prices.

PGM.note: Substitution in auto catalysts and peak internal combustion engine demand weigh on outlook.

Potash.note: Normalized global supply balances steady agricultural demand, keeping prices neutral.

Aluminum.note: Chinese capacity caps and strong green transition demand tighten the market.

Diversified.note: Diversified exposure to copper and iron ore provides balanced macro risk.
